description: This file is a shell test script for simulating and testing various object corruption scenarios in a Git repository. It includes functions to manipulate Git object files to create corrupt or missing objects and defines a series of test cases to verify Git's behavior in these scenarios.

methods.name: obj_to_file
methods.description: Converts a Git object reference to the corresponding file path in the object store.

methods.name: corrupt_byte
methods.description: Corrupts a specific byte in a Git object file by overwriting it with a null byte.
